learn.canDo: Size a read-heavy service from its numbers, choose the store, cache and ID scheme, and defend 301 versus 302.
learn.why: The URL shortener is the interview warm-up. The signal is estimating first and designing the read path second.
learn.keyIdea: Estimate first; the read path decides the design.

learn.canDo: Design a distributed key-value store: consistent hashing, replication with quorums, and an LSM engine, with the cost of each.
learn.why: KV stores are the textbook for placement, replication and consistency. Each choice has a number behind it.
learn.keyIdea: Placement, replication and engine each answer a different question.

learn.canDo: Design payments that charge once, lose nothing and stay auditable: idempotency keys, an outbox, isolation and a ledger.
learn.why: Payments test whether you know what 'exactly once' costs. Each guarantee has its own mechanism.
learn.keyIdea: Money moves once and leaves a trail.

learn.canDo: Prevent double booking under a rush with atomic claims, short holds and a waiting room.
learn.why: Seat contention is hot-row contention in disguise. The answer is atomic claims and metered demand.
learn.keyIdea: Make the claim atomic and meter the crowd.

learn.canDo: Absorb a blast above the provider's rate with a queue, keyed retries, a dead-letter queue and per-user limits.
learn.why: Notifications combine queues, retries and idempotency. The trade-off is loss, duplicates, delay and spam.
learn.keyIdea: Turn the provider's rate limit into delay, not loss.

learn.canDo: Choose fan-out on write, read or a hybrid from the follower distribution, and cache feeds.
learn.why: The feed is the classic skew problem: a few accounts carry most of the work.
learn.keyIdea: Push for the many, pull for the few.

learn.canDo: Design a polite, fast crawler: a per-host frontier, politeness as a throughput cap, a Bloom filter and a DNS cache.
learn.why: A crawler is politeness plus scale. The memory for ten billion URLs is its own question.

learn.canDo: Design a limiter shared by many instances: central counts with periodic sync, and a defined failure mode.
learn.why: Rate limiters are asked as systems and as classes. The failure mode is the part people forget.
learn.keyIdea: Decide what happens when the shared state is gone.

learn.canDo: Design chat with persistent connections, acknowledged delivery with dedup, presence on demand and sharded history.
learn.why: Chat packs connections, delivery guarantees, storage and presence into one question.
learn.keyIdea: The green dot is the expensive part.

learn.canDo: Serve prefix lookups in milliseconds by precomputing top completions in a trie, with a refresh policy.
learn.why: Autocomplete is a latency budget. Moving ranking from query time to build time is the idea.
learn.keyIdea: Compute the answer before anyone asks.

learn.canDo: Design dispatch: an adaptive spatial index, an update interval chosen by position error, and batch matching.
learn.why: Ride hailing blends geospatial indexing, a write firehose and an assignment decision.
learn.keyIdea: Batch the decision; adapt the index.

learn.canDo: Design a video pipeline: resumable uploads, parallel segment encodes, a right-sized ladder, a CDN and storage tiers.
learn.why: Video shows how each stage of a pipeline has its own bottleneck and its own bill.
learn.keyIdea: Delivery is the bill; parallelism is the speed.
